title: The dollar deposit bridge: India's 2026 NRI financing surge
interpretation: Source-linked RBI facility mobilisations and balance-of-payments flows are related but have different periods, gross/net definitions and institutional perimeters. Never equate them directly.

terms.eligible: Fresh FCNR(B) deposits eligible for a dollar-rupee swap between banks and the RBI. Eligible external commercial borrowings and overseas foreign-currency borrowings were also part of the wider facility.

snapshots.vintage: Reported after the deposit-mobilisation cutoff, with an updated FCNR deposit total

facility.original_relation: The 8 June circular prescribed eligibility and swap tenor. The 14 August press release advanced the FCNR(B) deposit cutoff to 31 August while ECB and OFCB windows continued to 31 December 2026.

financial_flow_components.label: Other capital including errors and omissions, net

bop.note: The RBI labels aggregate B 'Capital Account (Net)' and includes financial components there. Negative monetary movements mean an increase in reserves on a transactions basis, not valuation-adjusted reserve-stock growth.

cautions: Facility mobilisation values are gross reported inflows over the facility's own defined window; they are not net NRI deposits in the balance of payments.
The balance-of-payments NRI deposit net inflow of US$125.6bn is within banking capital of US$125.2bn; never add it as another component to aggregate B.
April–September BoP aggregates cannot be reconciled exactly to June–August or June–September facility snapshots by subtraction alone.

Holding all other BoP flows fixed while changing NRI deposits is an illustrative accounting stress test, not a forecast for capital inflows, RBI intervention, exchange rates or actual reserve-stock changes.
A financial inflow can support the external balance yet create a liability that must eventually be serviced or rolled over. The maturity and hedge terms matter.
The RBI reports source rounding, partially revised prior-year values and preliminary current-year values; comparison may be revised later.
